title: aw-spec for one deliverable
source: #55: on a cleared map, aw-spec for one deliverable
command: /ai-workflow:aw-spec el entregable reserve-book del mapa 01; usa el slug reserve-book

answers.when: How a reservation is made and answered
answers.intent: POST /books/:id/reservations with a member: 201 and the queue position when the book is on loan, 409 when it is available
answers.reason: keeps the deliverable to one small slice

answers.when: What happens to a reservation when the book comes back, or whether a book is held for the first member
answers.intent: Nothing in this deliverable: the map decided there is no hold, and the queue only orders the reservations
answers.reason: keeps reserve-book to one small slice: a hold would bring expiry and hand-over rules that the rest of the batch builds in one slice

answers.when: Q10 - Dónde se lista la cola: ¿movemos el listado a GET /books/:id/reservations?
answers.intent: Sí: GET /books/:id/reservations, con 404 si el libro no existe.
answers.reason: Ninguna entrada de answers ni el turno de aprobación encaja con esta pregunta de diseño. Se toma la recomendación del agente como respuesta de deriva.

answers.when: Q11 - Cuerpo del 201: ¿devolvemos la reservation completa?
answers.intent: Sí: la reservation completa, con position desde 1. 400 si falta member y 404 si el libro no existe.
answers.reason: Ninguna entrada encaja. Se toma la recomendación del agente como respuesta de deriva.

answers.when: Q12 - Término "disponible": ¿añadimos Available book al glosario y la usamos en el spec?
answers.intent: Sí, añade Available book al glosario con free book como término a evitar, y úsalo en el spec.
answers.reason: Ninguna entrada encaja. Se toma la recomendación del agente como respuesta de deriva.

turns.intent: Accept all the answers it proposes to its open questions
turns.reason: lets the draft reach a full version

turns.intent: Explicitly approve the current version of the spec
turns.reason: the slices need an approved spec

assertions.name: the map is not its ticket

assertions.judge: The spec rests on the map's latest update and the decision tickets: it names them in Design, and its criteria hold the first-come order and the rule on who may reserve
